deadline.quote: Submit your application by December 1 (midnight EST) and pay the $105 application fee

gre_general.value: EEB no longer accepts GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: the Yale EEB program no longer accepts GRE scores (from either the general GRE or the Biology GRE)

gre_subject.value: The Biology Subject GRE is not accepted either.
gre_subject.quote: the Yale EEB program no longer accepts GRE scores (from either the general GRE or the Biology GRE)

supervisor.value: Contact prospective advisors before applying; fit with a faculty advisor weighs heavily, and students also do two rotations.
supervisor.quote: Students should not apply for the graduate program unless they have already been in contact with one or more prospective faculty advisors in the department.

funding.quote: students receive guaranteed financial support, participate in research rotations, take graduate courses

also.quote: Every PhD student receives a funding package that covers the full cost of tuition and provides a stipend to cover basic living costs like rent, food, and books — for a minimum of five years.

entry_route.value: No minimum requirement apart from an undergraduate degree by the start date.
entry_route.quote: there are no minimum requirements, apart from an undergraduate degree by your matriculation date, for admission into EEB at Yale.

also.quote: A Master's degree is not required to apply for a PhD at Yale, although some programs give preference to applicants with post-baccalaureate training.

notes: Interviews are usually in mid to late January; international students may interview remotely.
